notes.title: Wacky West – Optimization & New Content Update ⚡
notes.content: [p]This update focuses on performance improvements, gameplay polish, and some exciting new features:[/p][h3]Major Changes[/h3][list][*][p][b]Endless Mode[/b]: A brand-new mode unlocked after finishing [b]Western Run[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Final Bosses[/b]: Both [b]Run East[/b] and [b]Run West[/b] now feature completely redesigned final boss encounters.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Gameplay & Levels[/h3][list][*][p][b]Cave levels optimized[/b] for smoother performance.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Long Cave levels[/b] now feature enemies.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Western Run[/b] optimized for GPU performance.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]“one-of-three” choices and shops[/b] during final boss fights.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Landmine hazards[/b] are now deadlier.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Settings & UI[/h3][list][*][p]Added new settings:[/p][list][*][p]Simplified UI option.[/p][/*][*][p]FPS Limiter.[/p][/*][*][p]Floating texts toggle.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Fixes & Tweaks[/h3][list][*][p]Corrected tooltip description mistakes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Trashbag addon[/b] fixed – now significantly more powerful.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rusty Spring addon[/b] fixed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bullet Casing addon icon[/b] corrected.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]mutants T-posing[/b] at a distance.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]visual glitch[/b] on Run North when crossing gates.[/p][/*][*][p]Some nearly silent sounds now play at proper volume.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Weapon projectile trails[/b] updated for better performance.[/p][/*][/list]

Added [b]“one-of-three” choices and shops[/b] during final boss fights.

notes.title: Wacky West – Update Notes
notes.content:
Howdy folks! 🤠
Here’s what’s new in this update:

[list]
[*] Player Sprint: You can now sprint forward by holding W — added thanks to community feedback so you can hit the action faster!
[*] More Zombies: Long cave sections are now packed with even more undead varmints.
[*] Extender Fix: Extender display issues have been fixed.
[*] Controller Update: Added joystick support for gamepads and Steam Deck.
[/list]

Thanks for riding with us and keep sharing your thoughts – your feedback shapes Wacky West!

notes.title: Wacky West – Update Notes
notes.content:
Howdy folks! 🤠
Here’s what’s new in this update:

Engine Upgrade: Updated Unreal Engine from 5.5 → 5.6 for improved stability and future features.

DLSS Setting: DLSS for NVIDIA GPUs is now disabled by default. You can still manually enable it in the graphics options.

Visual Updates:
[list]
[*] Refreshed player avatar icon.
[*] Updated minigun icon for a sharper look.
[*] Boss Health Bar: Moved higher on the screen for better visibility during fights.
[/list]

Thanks for playing and keep sending us your feedback – it really helps polish Wacky West!
